AgentPatchRequest.description: Omitted fields retain their value. Null scalar/runtime/model_config values retain their value. Empty description/instructions clear them. runtime.options replaces the map; {} clears it, null retains it. mcp_servers null or {} clears the map. model_config with only selector updates selection; other configuration fields use the existing whole-profile update semantics.

RecreateAgentRequest.description: No configuration rebuilds the current Agent. Configuration with no mask performs the existing full replacement, retaining the current Runtime/model when the replacement does not select them. A nonempty mask requires configuration; only selected fields are replaced. Parent and child mask paths cannot coexist. Unknown masks return invalid_field_mask. Recreate sets desired_state=running. Role and template creation are not replacement fields.
